title: ALKAN Public Finance Signal — Input
description: Retrieves PUBLIC Seattle building-permit records and produces explainable public project activity signals. No creditworthiness is determined. Delivery to ALKAN only occurs when sendToAlkan=true AND dryRun=false AND the required secrets are configured.

jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction
jurisdiction.description: Only "seattle" is supported in this version.

dateFrom.title: Date from (YYYY-MM-DD)
dateFrom.description: Start of the application/issue date window (inclusive). Must not be after Date to.

dateTo.title: Date to (YYYY-MM-DD)
dateTo.description: End of the application/issue date window (inclusive).

updatedSince.title: Updated since (ISO-8601)
updatedSince.description: Incremental mode: only fetch records whose source update timestamp is newer than this. Leave empty to use the stored checkpoint, or a date window.

permitStatuses.title: Permit statuses filter
permitStatuses.description: Optional list of permit statuses to include (case-insensitive). Empty = all statuses.

permitTypes.title: Permit types filter
permitTypes.description: Optional list of permit type keywords to include (matched against the official permit type). Empty = all types.

tradeKeywords.title: Trade keywords
tradeKeywords.description: Keywords used for deterministic construction-scope classification of the official permit description. Does not filter records.

minDeclaredValue.title: Minimum declared project value
minDeclaredValue.description: Only include records whose official declared project value is >= this amount. 0 = no minimum. Must be >= 0.

maxRecords.title: Max records
maxRecords.description: Maximum number of records to process this run. Default 100, hard maximum 500.

allowBackfill.title: Allow backfill (> 90 day range)
allowBackfill.description: Explicit backfill flag. Required to request a date range longer than 90 days. Default false.

includeContacts.title: Include contact details
includeContacts.description: If false (default), phone/email are removed from output; only contact role and availability are preserved.

sendToAlkan.title: Send to ALKAN
sendToAlkan.description: If true AND dryRun is false AND secrets are configured, deliver signed batches to the ALKAN ingestion endpoint.

dryRun.title: Dry run
dryRun.description: If true (default), never deliver to ALKAN — only push sanitized records to the Apify dataset.
